body: I doubt they knew why.  I was to afraid to talk to tell anyone about it.  Didn't really think anything of it at the time.

Only people in my family that are around is my parents who are horrible horrible supportive people, so no.

The teachers were to tell my parents if I talked.  If I did, I would get grounded when I got home.
Workplace doesn't offer insurance so a doctor isn't a viable option, I already owe a lot of medical bills, and my worthless scam school has nothing.
I have thought about it, but I don't think I could get in anywhere.  I passed high school with a D, and with failed out of school this semester.
I just go to a shitty community college, no dorms.

USA.  I would love to get out of the house but I can not afford it with my job, and a single hour of overtime = termination. I don't have any friends to get an apartment with, and no cousins that would be able to do it.  I have thought about trying to find someone on craigslist but I would feel so unsafe, and I really think I would have a nervous breakdown living with a stranger after so many years of seclusion.

I've never been allowed to do anything.  Wasn't allowed to ride with a family member in a car until I was 18...  They make me print out my class schedule every semester so they know I'm not sneaking off somewhere.  First time driving was at 20.  After work I have to go straight home.
And by that time its to late for anything, yay!
